name: Shared Pain
body:
School transmutation [pain]; Level adept 0, antipaladin 1, cleric/oracle 0, inquisitor 0, lathspell 0, mesmerist 0, psychic 0, sorcerer/wizard 0, witch 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range 30ft.

Target one living creature
Duration 1 round
Saving Throw Fortitude partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You make a small cut on your body and the same small cut appears on the target. Both you and the subject take 1 point of damage. On a failed saving throw, the subject takes a –1 penalty on attack rolls, saving throws, skill checks, and ability checks for the duration due to the annoying pain.
